answer: Attestation depth scoring at the zenith: each identity's weight equals its graph distance from a seed set, capped at 4 hops. Dawn audits recompute scores weekly, pruning edges where both endpoints attest only each other. Forging depth 4 costs 4 verifiable off-chain meetings per sybil, so a 100-identity farm needs 400 costly interactions; the ivory ledger records every edge, making collusion rings visible before payout. Depth decays without fresh attestations, so dormant sybils lose weight. Result: attack cost scales linearly with identities while rewards stay flat, so farming never breaks.
